name: Hooked
storyline:
The world is dying, but love lives on.

You are a tiny Sugar Glider in a world that shows no mercy. Corrosive acid rains, lethal radiation, and toxic gasesrising from the depths have turned the land and sea into a death trap.

But you won't give up. Your beloved is locked in a cage, held by a greedy Merchant. To buy her freedom, you must face the relentless elements and fish in the most hostile waters ever known.

Will you brave the deadly abyss to bring her back?
summary: An extraction fishing experience with inventory management and upgrades
